title: Quantyra optical path spacers
description: 25, 50 and 100 mm added stop-spacing modules for the Quantyra keyed optical fixture. CAD-compatible; physical spacer fit untested. Editable OpenSCAD, exact STL meshes and documentation under CERN-OHL-S-2.0. Patent pending. New version DOI pending publication. Source Location: https://github.com/Quantyra/optical-path-spacers.
